title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #650: Divisibility Representation in Intervals. Status: OPEN

title: Countdivisible
content: Given A ⊆ {1,...,N} and an interval [a, a+2N), count how many integers in this interval are divisible by some element of A. ((Finset.Icc a (a + 2 * N)).filter (fun x => ∃ d ∈ A, d ∣ x)).card

title: Mincoverage
content: f(A, N) = the minimum count over all intervals of length 2N. sInf {k : ℕ | ∃ a : ℕ, a ≥ 1 ∧ countDivisible A N a = k}

title: F
content: f(m) = the minimum of minCoverage over all A ⊆ {1,...,N} with |A| = m. sInf {k : ℕ | ∃ A : Finset ℕ, A ⊆ Finset.range (N + 1) ∧ A.card = m ∧ minCoverage A N = k}

title: Erdos Saranyi Lower Bound
content: **Erdős-Sarányi Lower Bound**: f(m) ≫ √m.  There exists a constant c > 0 such that for all sufficiently large m and N, every A ⊆ {1,...,N} with |A| = m covers at least c√m integers in every interval of length 2N. ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ m N : ℕ, m ≥ 1 → N ≥ m → (f m N : ℝ) ≥ c * Real.sqrt m

title: Erdos Upper Bound Conjecture
content: **Erdős's Conjecture (OPEN)**: f(m) ≪ √m.  If true, combined with the lower bound this would give f(m) ≍ √m. ∃ C : ℝ, C > 0 ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 → ∃ N : ℕ, N ≥ m ∧ (f m N : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.sqrt m

title: Erdos 650
content: The known result: f(m) ≫ √m (Erdős-Sarányi). The open question: is f(m) ≍ √m? ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ m N : ℕ, m ≥ 1 → N ≥ m → (f m N : ℝ) ≥ c * Real.sqrt m := erdos_saranyi_lower_bound
